label: Embedding

shape.name: nested-octahedral-coordinate-lattice
shape.description: Three exact octahedral wire lattices, six coordinate half-axes, and small point-node accents. Straight edges distinguish it from all curved Provider forms.
shape.silhouette: Six pointed coordinate tips and clean diamond facets with no filled faces.
shape.label: 八面体の座標格子

motion.phaseMeaning: For every shell edge: 0 at its midpoint →1 at either endpoint. For the six axes: 0 at the origin →1 at outer coordinate vertices. Node accents have phase 1.
rules: Animate brightness on anchored coordinates; never integrate particle positions over time.
Keep all structural points visible when idle, offline, or at zero activity.
Health selects one uniform color for the whole object; group is never a color category.
Use bounded, modulo-wrapped time. Activity changes speed and pulse amplitude, not the silhouette.
Reduced motion uses the rest coordinates and constant per-point weight.
motion.suggestion: Send symmetric light packets from edge midpoints to their fixed coordinate endpoints; let endpoint accents glow on arrival. Keep every edge anchored and readable.

provenance: Approved monitoring-galaxy point-cloud form study; final deterministic provider geometry.

rendering.seedUsage: Stable visual variation only; never make silhouette depend on seed or elapsed time.
